Generative AI is redefining creativity. Ensuring that these systems are safe, controllable, and respectful of intellectual property is one of the most important open research challenges in the field. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is building next-generation multimodal guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models powering Firefly.com. Our goal extends beyond reactive blocking; we are developing model-level guidance mechanisms that proactively steer generation away from IP-violating concepts while preserving creative intent and usability. 

We are seeking a Applied Scientist with strong multimodal depth and research instincts to help define and develop the frontier of IP-aware generative modeling. This role sits at the intersection of generative model alignment, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale inference systems. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Inference-Time Alignment & Optimization 

Research and implement inference-time control techniques (guided decoding, constrained sampling, classifier guidance, reward-based steering). 

Optimize large multimodal systems for low-latency, production-scale deployment without sacrificing alignment quality. 

Identify and mitigate failure modes in generative pipelines at scale. 

Rapid Scientific Experimentation 

Develop and complete rigorous experiments to evaluate trade-offs between creativity, fidelity, and IP safety. 

Develop new evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for multimodal IP compliance. 

Contribute novel technical insights that may lead to publications or internal intellectual property. 

Vision-Language & Multimodal Reasoning 

Advance the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal foundation models for semantic IP understanding. 

Explore joint reasoning between perception and generation systems to enable real-time steering. 

Experiment how various techniques, e.g. multimodal embeddings, cross-attention mechanisms, etc., can be used for safety-aware inference. 

Multimodal IP-Aware Generative Modeling 

Develop novel approaches for integrating IP constraints directly into generative model behavior. 

Investigate controllable generation techniques that shift models from post-hoc blocking toward guided, alignment-aware synthesis. 

Develop training and fine-tuning strategies that embed guardrail signals into model representations. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Architect and evolve the Firefly IP Guard pipeline across first-party and third-party generative models. 

Collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers and other key partners like applied ethics, legal etc., to translate scientific advances into deployed systems. 

Communicate with other non-technical collaborators to help drive awareness about the implemented technologies. 

Drive end-to-end experimentation, from hypothesis formulation through model implementation and large-scale evaluation. 

Contribute to the broader research strategy around generative AI alignment and safety within Adobe. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML or generative AI research (industry or academia). 

Strong background in large-scale generative models (diffusion models, multimodal transformers, autoregressive systems). 

Deep experience with model fine-tuning, alignment strategies, and representation learning. 

Expertise in Vision-Language Models or multimodal foundation models. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), with experience of training and deploying large models. 

Scientific & Systems Rigor 

Strong experimental development and statistical evaluation skills. 

Experience analyzing complex failure modes in multimodal systems. 

Understanding of large-scale inference systems and production ML constraints. 

Ability to navigate open-ended research spaces and identify high-leverage problems. 

AI-Accelerated Development 

Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows to rapidly prototype, experiment, and scale research impact. 

Comfort operating in an AI-augmented development environment, using generative tools to increase iteration speed, code quality, and research throughput. 

Ability to combine scientific rigor with high-velocity execution. 

Collaborative Approach 

Experience working in cross-functional research-to-product environments. 

Ability to clearly communicate complex scientific ideas to diverse collaborators. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Research contributions in controllable generation, alignment, AI safety, or multimodal learning. 

Publications in leading conferences (CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) or equivalent industry impact. 

Experience deploying generative models to large user bases. 

Background in safety evaluation frameworks, explainability or adversarial robustness.

Job Details

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

RAG System Design:

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion:

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization:

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement:

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support:

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring:

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred:

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Success in This Role Looks Like:

High-recall, low-latency retrieval pipelines that enhance LLM outputs with accurate, relevant context

Modular, reusable RAG components that can be applied across use cases and domains

Continuous improvement of retrieval relevance and reasoning alignment through experimentation and monitoring

Strong collaboration with AI engineers, prompt engineers, and data owners to maintain data quality and user trust

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join the Firefly team within Adobe's Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization. Firefly is Adobe's family of creative generative AI models that power next-generation creative experiences across Adobe's products. In this role, you will work at the frontier of multimodal AI by starting from foundational models and adapting them for various real-world use cases and products. You will develop and build innovative generation pipelines, bring powerful research into production, and collaborate closely with research, product, and infrastructure teams to invent the future of AI-powered creativity.

What you'll Do

Foundational Model Development & Adaptation

Engage with large-scale pretrained models for multimodal generation (image, text, video, and beyond) and tailor them to support Adobe Firefly products and features.

Research, prototype, and integrate brand-new techniques from the latest literature into production-grade generation pipelines.

Construct and refine innovative end-to-end pipelines for multimodal generation, balancing quality, performance, and scalability.

Data Strategy & User Workflows

Work alongside data and research teams to review, modify, and recommend improvements to data strategies that support model training and fine-tuning.

Analyze and iterate on user-facing workflows, translating product requirements into model and pipeline build decisions.

Contribute to dataset curation, annotation strategy, and evaluation frameworks for generative models.

Technical Excellence & Collaboration

Participate in build reviews and code reviews, upholding high standards for code quality, architecture, and reproducibility.

Build and maintain robust technical documentation, design documents, and engineering standards.

Collaborate with partner teams across ASML and contribute actively to technical roadmaps and cross-functional planning.

Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through pairing, code review, and internal technical talks.

What you need to succeed

Technical Depth

5+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, with a strong focus on deep learning for computer vision or multimodal generation.

Practical experience handling extensive, intricate ML codebases and current ML frameworks like PyTorch or Tensorflow in live settings.

Demonstrated experience in constructing and refining ML pipelines on a large scale — covering model training and fine-tuning all the way through inference and deployment.

Solid understanding of generative model architectures (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, GANs, VAEs) and experience adapting or training them for applied use cases.

Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals, including system build, testing, and debugging.

Experience in distributed training or inference on GPU clusters; knowledge of frameworks like Slurm or similar is an advantage.

Domain & Collaboration

Extensive knowledge of multimodal generation workflows — especially image or video generation — and the capability to quickly adopt new methods from research.

Demonstrated experience collaborating cross-functionally with research scientists, product managers, and infrastructure engineers.

Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute meaningfully to roadmap discussions and architectural decisions.

Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a fast paced research and product environment.

Experience contributing to technical documentation, development proposals, or engineering standards.

Nice to Have

Experience with controllable generation, LoRA / fine-tuning workflows, or RLHF-based alignment techniques.

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps tooling.

Prior experience working in a creative AI or media technology domain.

Contributions to open-source ML projects or peer-reviewed publications.

Education

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.

Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, preferred.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Partner Manager at Adobe, you will take ownership of one of our most strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships, with primary responsibility for Germany and an additional overlay role across Adobe Central Europe, working closely with regional Partner Alliance Managers.

This role sits at the heart of Adobe’s growth strategy, with a clear mandate to scale partner-led pipeline, revenue, and customer impact across the Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. You will define and execute the joint strategy with a top-tier global partner, aligning Adobe’s technology, industry solutions, and go-to-market motions with the integrator’s consulting, delivery, and services capabilities across the German market, while ensuring regional consistency and leverage across Central Europe.

Operating in a complex, matrixed environment, you will engage with stakeholders ranging from alliance leaders and solution architects to senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Your success will be measured by your ability to translate strategic alignment into tangible business outcomes—accelerating partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, driving customer adoption, and building a scalable, high-impact partnership model across the region.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will act as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for a global systems integrator in Germany, while collaborating with other Partner Alliance Managers to support and extend the partnership across Central Europe. You will shape joint priorities, lead executive alignment, and ensure disciplined execution across sales, marketing, and delivery teams.

You will develop and own Joint Business Plans that define shared objectives, investment areas, and success metrics, covering pipeline creation, bookings, customer adoption, and services attach. Working closely with Adobe Sales and Customer Success teams, you will ensure partner opportunities are identified early, properly registered, and executed seamlessly through to customer success.

A key part of the role is driving go-to-market impact. You will collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Partner Solution Consulting teams to design joint industry plays, solution offerings, and demand-generation initiatives. This includes sponsoring and shaping executive events, campaigns, and thought leadership activities that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth in Germany, while aligning with broader Central Europe priorities.

As a senior leader within Adobe’s partner ecosystem, you will bring a strong point of view on digital experience transformation, advising partners and customers on market trends and how Adobe’s full Experience Cloud portfolio can address their most critical business challenges. You will also play an important role in fostering a culture of accountability, ambition, and continuous improvement across the partnership and the wider regional partner community.

What You need to succeed

You bring extensive experience in enterprise sales and strategic partnerships, with a proven track record of delivering results through large, complex partners. You have spent several years working directly with Global System Integrators or major consulting firms, ideally with strong exposure to the German market and experience operating across multiple countries or regions.

You combine strong commercial acumen with executive presence, enabling you to influence senior leaders and drive alignment at the highest levels. You are experienced in building and scaling partner businesses, developing joint value propositions, and translating strategy into execution that delivers measurable outcomes across both local and regional contexts.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive and resilient mindset, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. A bachelor’s degree is required; a master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

What if data collaboration between enterprises could be as seamless, intelligent, and real-time as consumer apps — but built with enterprise-grade scale, privacy, and performance?

Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (Real-Time CDP), part of Adobe Digital Experience, helps organizations unify known and anonymous data into real-time customer profiles. But profiles alone are not enough.

RTCDP Collaboration takes this further.
We are building the engine that enables organizations to securely collaborate on data — activating shared insights while preserving governance, scalability, and performance at massive scale. How does data actually move? How is it processed? How do we orchestrate workflows across systems, clouds, and partners in real time? How do we ensure trust, performance, and resilience while handling billions of events?
These are not theoretical questions. They are the engineering challenges we solve every day.
As a Senior Software Development Engineer in the UI team, you will not just implement features — you will shape how enterprise data collaboration happens inside the Adobe ecosystem. You will help design the systems that allow businesses to connect, activate shared insights, and ultimately deliver more meaningful customer experiences.
If you are driven by complexity, ownership, and architectural impact — this is your challenge.

Create the future Adobe products by building and maintaining complex and robust user interfaces for our customers

Own the outcome by taking the initiative and ownership for the application design efforts while always optimizing for quality, scalability and performance.

Raise the bar by focusing on continuously innovating and seeking novel methods for addressing complex technical distributed system challenges.

Be genuine, serve as a mentor, foster a collaborative environment and encourage and guide team members by being honest and direct.

Work with and across teams and domains to collaborate.

Act with clarity and precision, ensuring projects are driven with a strong sense of ownership and direction.

Strong Frontend Engineering Foundation

7–10+ years building complex, data-driven web applications

Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript

Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines

Familiarity with frontend test strategies across unit, integration, and E2E layers

Experience consuming and reasoning about REST and/or GraphQL APIs

Familiarity with backend development concepts (Node.js, Java, or similar is a plus)

Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases

Understanding of data models and metadata-driven systems

Ability to make frontend decisions informed by backend constraints

Comfortable participating in cross-layer architectural discussions

Experience working with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.)

Familiarity with frontend build tooling (Webpack, Vite, etc.)

Comfortable debugging pipeline or deployment issues

Experience integrating automated tests into build and release workflows

AI & Engineering Productivity

Experience using AI tools to improve development workflows

Interest in integrating AI-driven automation into testing, reviews, or documentation

The Adobe Digital Imaging Data Science Team is looking for a Data Scientist passionate about data and delivering an outstanding product experience. We use extensive product usage data and work closely with product managers, marketing managers, and software engineers to derive insights and build a foundation for reliable data-driven decision-making. You will focus on initiatives like product analytics, dashboards, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth and more. Your main role is to develop and maintain a strong data architecture that enhances reporting, analytics, and experimentation. Over time, you will apply predictive modeling and machine learning to help the organization improve customer experiences. Join us and drive meaningful change in Adobe’s most exciting areas!

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

About the Role

The Acrobat Product Marketing team is seeking a strategic Director of Product Marketing, Engagement to lead our Value Discovery team with a focus on delivering meaningful impact. This leader will shape how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

They will define the strategy that connects product innovation to sustained customer value, ensuring new and existing capabilities are clearly positioned, prioritized effectively, and reinforced across the full customer lifecycle. This role owns the narrative and sequencing of key experiences so what we build is not only understood, but consistently used.

Working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Growth, Lifecycle, GTM, and others, this leader will drive adoption, increase repeat engagement, and translate product improvements into measurable, long-term impact for the business.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Value Discovery strategy, shaping how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

Design and operationalize a cross-channel engagement framework that ensures new and existing capabilities are introduced, reinforced, and re-surfaced at the right moments across the customer lifecycle.

Develop engagement messaging framework for key capabilities grounded in user value and existing workflows

Build an always-on content strategy that employs trends, cultural moments, and seasonal events to promote new and existing value

Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Design, Growth, Lifecycle to align engagement strategy with roadmap priorities and business goals.

Embed audience expertise, behavioral insights and adoption data into strategic decision-making to influence product direction.

Drive measurable improvements in feature adoption, depth of usage, and multi-tool engagement.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic product marketing leader who drives behavior change—not just awareness.

A builder of scalable engagement systems, not one-off campaigns.

A strong cross-functional operator who can influence Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and GTM partners and align teams around shared adoption goals.

A problem solver with a customer-first approach who translates workflows and user insights into clear, compelling value narratives.

A data-driven operator who uses adoption metrics, usage patterns, and experimentation to continuously refine strategy.

A leader who can balance long-term critical thinking alongside hands-on execution and operational excellence.

A compelling storyteller who can articulate value in a way that drives clarity, urgency, and action internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years in Product Marketing, Engagement, Lifecycle, or a related field in a subscription-based business, with clear ownership of adoption and engagement metrics.

Proven track record of increasing feature adoption, usage depth, retention, or multi-product engagement.

Experience building cross-channel engagement strategies (in-product, email, paid, owned).

Comfort working closely with Product & Design teams, shaping roadmaps through customer insight, influencing prioritization, and embedding go-to-market thinking into product development.

Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and prioritize investments.

Experience building and leading high-performing teams and influencing senior partners.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across functions.

A passion for modernizing a legacy product with a clear vision for how AI can drive everyday utility, prove ongoing value, and unlock Acrobat’s next phase of growth.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a dynamic Director of Technology Strategic Sourcing to lead high‑impact technology categories. Collaborating with the Head of Global Strategic Sourcing, you will lead teams of category managers covering over $2.5B in annual spend. Are you a builder and leader who is comfortable in setting strategy, driving execution, developing talent, and influencing senior levels in a fast‑paced, global environment? What you'll Do 

Partner closely with internal customers to understand priorities, unlock value, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Build and continuously evolve multi‑year category strategies aligned to business roadmaps, budgets, and risk posture.

Help standardize technology buying through unified source‑to‑pay processes and contracting standards.

Lead sourcing and cross-functional teams across multiple categories and initiatives from strategy development through sourcing, contracting, and implementation.

Develop organizational capability by mentoring, coaching, and building high‑performing sourcing leaders and teams.

Drive process improvements that increase customer happiness, reduce cycle time, and deliver efficiency gains while ensuring compliance with policies and mitigating supplier risk.

Proven track record in building trusted relationships with diverse partners across all levels (including senior-most levels of an organization) and influence decision‑making that aligns the interests of diverse teams.

Strong people-leadership capabilities, with a track record of attracting, developing, training and retaining outstanding talent.

Experience leading high-profile, complex negotiations with multi-faceted relationships (buy from, sell to, joint go-to-market, etc).

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in London.

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

Adobe is transforming the enterprise content supply chain with intelligent brand solutions that redefine how large organizations create, govern, and scale content. We are looking for a Senior Developer to build of Brand Brain’s core services and infrastructure. This role is ideal for a senior full stack engineer who can design and build these key AI-powered content workflows that will help organizations create on-brand assets at scale. You will work across backend, AI orchestration layers, creative tooling, agentic workflows etc. This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You will have an opportunity to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and can take a feature from concept to production. You will help architect build technology that helps enterprises create on-brand content at scale by building robust backend services, APIs and platforms that integrate Brand Brain into Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise apps.

The Opportunity

Adobe leads in creating world-class software solutions, and we are excited to welcome a new Software Development Engineer 5 to our vibrant team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is an outstanding chance to join a cooperative and driven environment where your work directly influences the success of innovative projects.

Responsibilities

Architect and deliver foundational systems that enable enterprises to build on-brand content at a global scale.

Develop strong backend services, APIs, and integration layers that embed Brand Brain deeply within the Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise platforms.

Drive engineering excellence across performance, reliability, observability, and secure-by-default building.

Contribute to crafting long-term platform architecture in a fast-paced, highly visible product area.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve foundational architecture, including service boundaries, domain models, APIs, and internal platform capabilities supporting high-throughput, low-latency workloads.

Build and implement scalable microservices and AI orchestration layers powering intelligent content workflows and agentic systems.

Build strong APIs and connectors that connect Brand Brain with Adobe products and third-party enterprise software.

Ensure platform compliance with strict SLAs for availability, scalability, latency, and data governance.

Establish guidelines for observability, incident management, prioritization, and cost efficiency.

Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-powered features to validate new product experiences.

Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and technical mentorship.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of experience building high-quality backend systems and microservices with strong emphasis on scalability, resilience, and performance.

Deep proficiency in backend development using Python or Java (both preferred).

Strong experience designing, building, and operating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at scale.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed systems.

Strong foundation in system build, modern architecture patterns, and engineering guidelines.

Demonstrated ability to take features from concept to production in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Build, and AI/ML teams.

Nice to Have

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, Content Management Systems (CMS), or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with large-scale data platforms, indexing, or search systems.

Experience integrating platforms across complex product ecosystems.

Exposure to Adobe or third-party creative ecosystems (e.g., Photoshop, Express, InDesign, Figma).

Experience shipping AI-powered features or working with agentic workflows.

Adobe Firefly’s ASML group invites research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large generative AI models. This role emphasizes images and videos. We strive to advance generative AI technology while guaranteeing models possess excellent quality and control.

We are especially looking for candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-level pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role has a direct effect on the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully assess sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. Emphasize improving instruction compliance, controllability, and visual clarity in pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Develop and maintain robust evaluation pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, robustness, and safety metrics.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

What you'll need to succeed

Possession of a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training concentrating on image and video generation and editing.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers.

Strong history of publishing in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing, Growth & Platforms to drive user and revenue expansion for Adobe's Creator portfolio. In this role, you will coordinate the growth strategy for Firefly, Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere across both web and mobile platforms.

You will be responsible for shaping the expansion approach for this ecosystem and lead a cross functional team passionate about driving impact across two key areas:

Cross-Application Growth: Scale our products within Adobe’s creative ecosystem by integrating workflows and optimizing acquisition funnels across internal and external touchpoints.

Portfolio Lifecycle Management (LCM): Develop our LCM system and omnichannel methods (email, push, in-app messaging, SMS or comparable experience) aimed at improving user engagement and retention.

What You Will Do

Drive Cross-Application Growth Strategies

Workflow Integration: Build cross-application workflows and incorporate Firefly's Generative AI tools into Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere.

Journey Optimization: Manage end-to-end user journeys.

Scale branded entry points across the product ecosystem. Support the development of a cross-app platform. Build viral loops and develop our trends and sharing roadmap to drive organic growth.

External Partnerships: Build strategic partnerships to define new entry points and workflows (e.g., LLM providers, hardware, and software partners).

Architect Portfolio Lifecycle Oversight (LCM)

Omnichannel Activation: Manage LCM channels across the Creator portfolio, including push, in-app, email, SMS, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Google Play.

Evergreen Engagement: Direct the evergreen LCM strategy with Outbound Product Marketing to sustain user engagement between major product releases.

Infrastructure Acceleration: Partner with Product and Engineering to advance infrastructure.

Platform modernization: Explore new ways to bring to bear Gen AI technologies to engage users and drive operational excellence.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Execution & Growth Operations

Growth Operations: Lead high-velocity multivariate testing frameworks to optimize acquisition funnels, monetization models, and user flows.

Product-Led Growth (PLG): Operationalize PLG loops - such as sharing, referrals, and asset remixing to improve user acquisition.

Executive Alignment: Align Engineering, Build, Product, and Marketing around unified growth objectives. Translate growth analytics into clear executive reporting.

What You Need to Succeed

Growth Leadership: 12+ years of leadership experience in growth marketing, product marketing, or product management. A proven record of scaling products to mass-market adoption within a multi-product ecosystem.

Mobile & Web Expertise: Deep experience driving user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies for applications.

Lifecycle & Ecosystem Experience: Proficiency in managing complex LCM channels and growth loops. Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing automation infrastructure (e.g., Adobe Journey Optimizer) is highly preferred.

Quantitative Rigor: Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated capability in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, user profiling, and A/B/multivariate experiment development.

Technical & Creative Proficiency: Ability to translate GenAI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models) into intuitive value propositions for creative professionals in building, video, and imaging.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive collaborators, product managers, and engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group is seeking research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large-scale generative AI models. They will concentrate on images and videos. Our aim is to advance generative AI and ensure models have high quality and controllability.

We are especially seeking candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-grade pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role directly influences the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully evaluate sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. This work emphasizes improving instruction adherence, controllability, and the visual quality of pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Define and build comprehensive evaluation frameworks and benchmarking pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, safety, and reliability, establishing guidelines and standards for the organization.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

Collaborate with technical leads to build long-term technical strategy and roadmap, while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and researchers to elevate team capability and impact.

What you'll need to succeed

Hold a Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related area.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training emphasizing the creation and modification of images and videos.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers

Strong history of publications in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to: 

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. 

Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. 

An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution 

Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. 

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. 

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. 

The Opportunity 

This position is a remote opportunity in the Abbott Diabetes Care Division. We are helping people with Diabetes lead healthier, happier lives. As a global leader in diabetes care, Abbott is constantly working to deliver the highest quality products and unwavering support to our customers. Consistent and accurate glucose monitoring is the foundation of any diabetes management plan, so we’re committed to continuous improvement in the way patients and professionals measure, track and analyze glucose levels. 

As a Senior Medical Science Liaison, you will be responsible for driving high impact medical and scientific engagement in support of Abbott Diabetes Care (ADC). This field based role strengthens ADC’s scientific leadership by delivering advanced scientific exchange, executing strategic territory planning, and generating measurable impacts and outcomes that influence Medical Affairs strategy. Senior MSLs fulfill all core MSL duties while also leading complex initiatives, mentoring colleagues, shaping evidence generation priorities, and ensuring high quality insight generation that measurably advances ADC’s strategic objectives. This is a field based opportunity.

What You’ll Do

Provide national and regional scientific leadership by executing high impact initiatives with leading academic centers, clinical systems, and diabetes networks, resulting in measurable outcomes, evidence opportunities, and medical strategy execution.

Demonstrate expert level regional and national territory planning, including a deep understanding of clinical trends, system priorities, emerging influencers, and unmet needs.

Serve as a senior scientific expert and mentor, coaching MSL colleagues in advanced scientific exchange, territory strategy, KOL development, documentation, and insight quality—resulting in stronger team capability and measurable improvements in field execution.

Lead or co lead high impact Medical Affairs projects, such as scientific training, publication planning, clinical research support, or process improvement, ensuring each initiative delivers defined outcomes and clear contributions to ADC objectives.

Provide strategic medical leadership at scientific congresses, leading Medical Affairs execution, managing field deployment, presenting scientific data and producing post meeting reports that translate into actionable outcomes and strategic next steps.

Act as a subject matter expert with comprehensive scientific knowledge, contributing to the development and refinement of scientific materials and ensuring consistent, high quality scientific communication across the organization.

 Support and mentor ADC Fellows, ensuring structured learning, co-presentation opportunities, and progression toward measurable competency outcomes.

Establish and maintain high impact scientific relationships with key thought leaders and external experts that measurably strengthen ADC’s scientific credibility and influence.

Develop and execute a robust, compliant territory engagement plan that aligns with regional scientific needs and ADC priorities, demonstrating consistent delivery of measurable outcomes tied to Medical Affairs goals.

Conduct high level scientific exchange with healthcare providers, managed care stakeholders, and advocacy groups, ensuring the information provided improves clinical understanding and leads to concrete educational or scientific outcomes.

Deliver expert level scientific presentations tailored to audience needs, demonstrating mastery of therapeutic area content and resulting in improved scientific comprehension and actionable follow up.

Capture, synthesize, and communicate high value field insights that directly influence strategic planning, evidence generation priorities, and cross functional alignment; ensure insights result in clear, documented impacts to organizational strategy.

Represent ADC at scientific congresses, translating scientific interactions and emerging data into actionable insights and measurable outcomes that support strategy refinement and execution.

Collaborate cross functionally while maintaining Medical Affairs independence, ensuring scientific accuracy and contributing to measurable improvements in cross functional readiness and execution.

Complete administrative responsibilities in a timely and compliant manner, including documentation, reporting, insights, and training—all contributing to high quality field operations and measurable compliance outcomes.

Experience You’ll Bring

Required

Terminal degree required: PhD, DNP, MD/DO, PharmD, or DMSc.

Minimum of 7 years of experience 

Minimum 4 years of Medical Affairs experience in pharmaceutical, medical device or biotech industries with demonstrated excellence in MSL competencies and a track record of delivering measurable strategic, scientific, and operational outcomes.

Demonstrated ability to lead and influence diverse stakeholders.

Strong analytical and strategic planning skills with a results and outcomes oriented mindset.

Ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, actionable insights that create measurable impact.

Commitment to compliance, scientific integrity, documentation excellence, and sustained scientific credibility.

Contributes to a cohesive and high performing team culture with measurable positive impact.

Deep, authoritative understanding of therapeutic area science.

Strong ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical data clearly.

Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos.

Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.

Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.

A oportunidade 

Esta posição tem local de trabalho em Recife/PE na Divisão de Medicamentos de Marca e Produtos Farmacêuticos.

Localidades: Recife/PE e região.

Como Executivo(a) de Vendas, vai atuar de forma estratégica na negociação, desenvolvimento e execução dos produtos Abbott junto a redes do varejo farmacêutico, associativismos e distribuidores, ampliando market share e sell-out das marcas prioritárias por meio do entendimento profundo das particularidades de cada cliente, da excelência na execução no ponto de venda e da construção de parcerias comerciais sustentáveis e de longo prazo..

O que você vai fazer 

Conduzir negociações e realizar vendas dos produtos Abbott junto redes, associativismos e distribuidores, por meio de transfer order (OL) ou venda direta, conforme políticas comerciais vigentes e elegibilidade do cliente;

Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos clientes, como sell-in, sell-out, giro, cobertura e dias de estoque (SIT - CD/Loja), utilizando auditorias de mercado, mapas de estoque, dados internos e informações fornecidas pelos próprios clientes;

Construir, em conjunto com os clientes, planos de Trade Marketing customizados e sustentáveis, alinhados às diretrizes estratégicas da Abbott, com foco em aceleração de sell-out, execução das marcas prioritárias e rentabilidade do negócio;

Desenvolver relacionamento próximo e estratégico com os principais stakeholders das contas sob sua responsabilidade, influenciando decisões comerciais e fortalecendo a parceria entre Abbott e clientes;

Garantir a correta exposição dos produtos nos pontos de venda, assegurando visibilidade, posicionamento estratégico e aderência às orientações de merchandising da companhia;

Realizar treinamentos de produtos isentos de prescrição para balconistas e de produtos sob prescrição para farmacêuticos, conforme diretrizes, materiais e políticas aprovadas pela Abbott;

Executar visitas regulares, planejadas às lojas, CDs e pontos estratégicos dos clientes atendidos, garantindo disciplina comercial, qualidade de execução e acompanhamento contínuo dos planos acordados;

Manter controles, registros e relatórios atualizados sobre visitas, negociações, planos de ação e resultados, conforme processos e ferramentas internas da companhia;

Cumprir integralmente as políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes corporativas da Abbott, incluindo o Código de Conduta Comercial;

Atuar em conformidade com as políticas e práticas de EHS (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), apoiando e participando das ações promovidas pela área.

Qualificações necessárias

Superior completo em Administração, Marketing ou Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.

Excel intermediário / avançado

Vivência em negociações comerciais

Disponibilidade para viagens

Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e atuar de forma colaborativa

Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal

Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados

Criatividade para propor soluções e melhorias

Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade

Experiência prévia em áreas comerciais, trade ou marketing

Capacidade de análise de dados e construção de indicadores

Facilidade para transitar entre atividades estratégicas e operacionais

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Minnetonka location in the EP division.

Main Purpose of Role

Under general supervision, supports assigned area Production Supervisor in ensuring the continuous flow of high-quality production through assigned work-cells in accordance with manufacturing obligations. Acts as the lead person in self-directed cells or teams. Assists in ensuring that high levels of productivity and product quality are consistently maintained, and helps coordinate efforts towards their continuous improvement.

What You’ll Work On

Responsible for coordinating production activity in assigned work areas, ensuring that product is continuously processed in accordance with build schedules.

Coordinates communication of work instructions to personnel in designated areas in accordance with supervisory objectives.

May perform direct manufacturing operations in support of build schedules, as directed or as necessary.

Performs regular process and quality performance audits of personnel, tooling and equipment in assigned areas.

Advises supervisor or other appropriate contact in the event of issues affecting the productivity of the cell.

Accumulates information for assigned areas regarding work in process inventory status and daily output quantities.

Assists in providing direct training to area operators as required. Provides feedback on defects encountered, and provides re-training support as necessary.

Accumulates and organizes data to support area continuous improvement plans, as directed.

Provides assistance in expediting priority product and tasks in assigned areas.

Performs inspection and determines disposition of rejects per required documentation, as directed.

Resolves and/or facilitates resolution of problems including identifying causes to prevent re-occurrence.

Support all Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments. Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.

Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned.

Works with a variety of production equipment, small hand tools, test equipment, and precision measuring instruments. Also uses standard office equipment such as telephone, fax/copier, and a personal computer with standard office software.

Works in a production or air-conditioned clean-room manufacturing environment; requires gowning attire to maintain a particle free environment. Low to moderate noise level. Minor exposure to chemicals. May work at a desk or workstation.

Requires a significant amount of sitting, stooping and walking; manual dexterity; ability to reach, hold, grasp, and move items. Subject to standing for extended periods of time. Must be able to perform occasional tasks requiring the physical lifting of equipment weighing up to approximately thirty pounds. Must be able to perform functions utilizing automated/manual equipment requiring correctable vision including color discrimination.

Shift 

Monday – Thursday, 4:45 AM – 3:15 PM, with potential overtime

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma / GED

Minimum 4 years related experience in the assembly of digital and analog circuitry/devices, including the demonstrated ability to provide work/lead direction to a team.

Must be able to demonstrate comprehensive product assembly techniques, related process knowledge, plus a mastery of appropriate skill sets as confirmed by cognizant Engineering and/or Production/Quality Assurance supervisory personnel.

Prior experience working in an air-conditioned clean-room manufacturing environment is required. Demonstrated ability to read and understand engineering drawings, schematics, diagrams, notes, and layouts.

Demonstrated ability to use frequently used hand tools; demonstrated eye-hand coordination and capable of working with small precision devices.

Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model preferred. Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment. Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment. Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.

Demonstrated verbal and written communication, interpersonal, organizational and basic math skills. Ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization. 

Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner. Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail. Ability to maintain regular and predictable attendance. Occasional scheduled overtime is a requirement of this position.

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 5 years medical device or related assembly experience is preferred.

The opportunity
Adobe is seeking Senior Staff Applied Scientists who excel at turning research breakthroughs into innovative product features. In this role, you will focus on scouting, adapting, and improvising the latest research to advance Adobe’s AI capabilities in the field of Natural Language, Image/Video generation, editing, and multimodal AI that impact millions of users.
We welcome outstanding candidates in all related technical fields, such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Natural Language Processing, Large language models.
Familiarity with inference optimization, performance trade-offs, and scalable integration will be an asset. We are looking for a candidate who is motivated by moving fast with research and innovation and wants their ideas to shape the future of Adobe products.

What you will do

Transform innovative research concepts into practical applications within the realm of Generative AI, LLMs, Reinforcement learning, Reasoning, Evaluations.

Prototype and experiment rapidly, demonstrating feasibility and business impact.

Push beyond academic results to develop and deploy practical, differentiated innovations for Adobe’s products.

Collaborate with world-class researchers and ML engineers to bring research ideas to production.

Publish and present your work in world-class scientific venues in AI/ML fields.

Develop and enhance GPU-accelerated pipelines for (customized) model training and inference, focusing on performance, scalability, and reliability.

Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Ph.D. or Masters or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, AI/ML or related fields and 10+ professional experience.

Research or industry experience in training AI/ML models in at least one of the following modalities: multimodal LLMs, Image, Video.

Proficiency in training and optimizing large-scale models, involving data curation, distributed training, and memory-efficient strategies.

Experience with post-training techniques such as fine-tuning, alignment or distillation.

Proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and experience scaling models on GPU/TPU clusters.

Excellent communication skills and a strong great teammate.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on large-scale generative model training.

Experience on synthetic data generation.

Previous involvement with product teams in technology transfers.

Experience of working with large-scale datasets

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise is bringing generative AI into real creative workflows—directly inside the tools customers already use. The Extensibility team builds and evolves GenStudio plugins (e.g., for Figma and other creative hosts) that connect in-product experiences to Firefly imaging workflows (generate image/similar, generative expand, remove background, etc.) and GenStudio enterprise workflows (templating/mapping, iteration, governance handoff).The problem we’re solving: enterprise creative teams want the speed of generative AI without leaving their native tools or rebuilding complex templates elsewhere. Today, moving between tools and web apps can break pixel-perfect designs, fragment iteration history, and make it harder to enforce enterprise guardrails. GenStudio plugins solve this by enabling in-tool generation and editing, mapping content to structured fields/roles (headline/body/CTA/on-image text), and handing off outputs to GenStudio for governance and activation—all while integrating with the right APIs and enterprise constraints.This role is frontend-first with basic full-stack expectations: you’ll mainly build UI and client architecture, and you’ll also be comfortable debugging service integrations, collaborating on API contracts, and making small backend contributions when needed.

What you’ll do

Build and ship GenStudio plugins using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a contemporary frontend framework (React/Web Components or similar).

Own user-facing workflows end-to-end: UI implementation, interaction design fidelity, state management, performance, accessibility, and reliability.

Integrate deeply with APIs (REST/GraphQL): handle auth flows, async job orchestration (polling), retries, error states, and instrumentation-friendly patterns.

Design for extensibility: implement flexible UI patterns and plugin architecture that can grow to new workflows, new hosts, and enterprise requirements.

Work closely with Product and Design: clarify requirements, surface edge cases early, and iterate quickly with high-quality execution.

Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing where appropriate, code reviews, build/release hygiene, and pragmatic tech debt management.

Mentor and support junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.

What you need to succeed

6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong frontend focus.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component-based UI development.

Proven experience integrating with APIs and building robust client-side systems around asynchronous workflows.

Strong CS fundamentals and practical software design skills.

Excellent communication skills; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

Nice to have

Experience building embedded/plugin UIs (Figma plugins, UXP panels, add-ins, extensions, or other constrained runtimes).

Basic backend experience (Node.js/services) and comfort working with logs/metrics and debugging cross-service issues.

Familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts and integrating AI capabilities into products.

Experience with build systems, CI/CD, and release processes (marketplace-style or enterprise deployments).

The Opportunity

At P50, you’ll be a technical leader shaping the plugin platform and engineering practices for extensibility at scale. You’ll drive architecture, guide major initiatives, and partner with PM/Design/Platform teams to deliver flexible, enterprise-ready plugin experiences. The problem we’re solving large creative organizations need a way to generate and iterate on brand-safe content inside existing creative workflows (where templates and day-to-day production happen). Without a plugin approach, teams are forced into tool switching, duplicated work, template rewrites, and brittle integrations that don’t scale across hosts or channels. We’re building an extensible plugin foundation that enables in-tool creation, consistent field-role mapping, robust API-driven generation/editing flows, and smooth handoff to GenStudio for downstream governance. This is still frontend-first, but you’ll be expected to operate confidently across boundaries—API design, service integration, and pragmatic full-stack problem solving.
 

What you’ll do

Lead the architecture of GeoStudio plugin experiences and shared frontend infrastructure (patterns, abstractions, extensibility strategy).

Drive complex, high-impact initiatives end-to-end: from ambiguous problem definition to delivery, rollout strategy, and iteration based on feedback.

Set engineering direction on quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability for plugin UI and integration layers.

Define and influence API contracts with backend/platform teams to ensure developer-friendly, scalable integrations.

Establish durable patterns for async workflows (job polling, progress UX, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and user trust).

Mentor and raise the bar: guide senior and junior engineers, run technical reviews, and create a culture of strong ownership and crisp execution.

Collaborate cross-functionally at a high level: align with PM/Design on roadmap, scope trade-offs, and extensible product design.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of industry experience with deep frontend expertise and strong architectural ownership.

Expert knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend architecture (component systems, state, performance, testing, build tooling).

Demonstrated success designing and shipping reusable, extensible frontend systems used across teams/products.

Strong experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth and async workflows, and designing resilient client systems.

Ability to provide technical leadership, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with engineering and product leadership.

Nice to have

Experience building products involving GenAI/LLMs (prompting patterns, model capabilities/limits, evaluation thinking, safety/guardrails).

Experience with enterprise requirements: entitlements, custom models, metering/usage considerations, compliance, and governance handoffs.

Practical full-stack skills (Node.js/microservices) and comfort owning small backend components when it unblocks the team.

Experience building developer-facing SDKs, shared libraries, or platform surfaces.

The Opportunity 

We’re the market leader in software products and services that power the world’s creative, document, and marketing ecosystems — from Creative Cloud and Document Cloud to Firefly, Express, and Experience Cloud. Over 85% of the Fortune 2000 rely on Adobe to fuel creativity, collaboration, and transformation.

As AI reshapes the creative and media landscape, Adobe stands at the intersection of creativity, marketing, and artificial intelligence — making us a trusted partner to CEOs, CMOs, CTOs, Studio executives, key talent and known directors as well as the next generation of creative and business leaders.

We are looking for an incredible individual to drive thought leadership, innovation, and commercial partnerships that inspire and accelerate enterprise adoption of GenAI in creativity, film and enterprises.

We’re looking for a rare hybrid — a technically fluent creative leader with deep roots in filmmaking, Hollywood, YouTube, or digital storytelling — who knows how to bridge art and technology to open doors, build partnerships, and create momentum in the market.

This person will be equal parts technologist, storyteller, and dealmaker — passionate about shaping the future of creativity, and skilled at translating innovation into business impact.

A successful candidate will have the technical AI chops to be respected by our eng and researchers, strong c-level relationship building skills, an ability to rally internal cross-functional partners and a founder mentality.

What You’ll Do

Ignite new business and partnerships: Lead Firefly Foundry engagements from concept to commercial deal, collaborating with Adobe’s enterprise sales and creative leadership teams.

Bridge creative vision with technology: Translate the needs of filmmakers, studios, creators, and brands into Foundry use cases that showcase “the art of the possible.”

Shape Adobe’s role in the entertainment and creator ecosystem: Build trusted relationships across studios, media companies, YouTube creators, agencies, and enterprise partners.

Advise and evangelize: Serve as a GenAI authority and creative industry leader with vision — presenting at customer meetings, partner events, and major conferences.

Collaborate across the enterprise: Work closely with Adobe Research, Firefly engineering, marketing, and product teams to test, validate, and influence future product directions.

Be hands-on: Prototype creative solutions, demo Firefly APIs and integrations, and bring ideas to life with tangible visual and storytelling proof points.

What you'll need to succeed

10+ years of experience across creative technology, media, entertainment, or enterprise partnerships.

A strong mix of technical fluency (AI, creative tools, APIs, cloud platforms) and creative depth (film, video, digital storytelling, YouTube, or content production).

Proven success launching or scaling products or experiences — ideally in a startup, 0→1, or innovation lab environment.

A network in the entertainment and creator ecosystem — and the confidence to navigate C-suite, studio, and creator conversations.

Entrepreneurial outlook: a “player-coach” who rolls up their sleeves and thrives in ambiguity.

High EQ, low ego, and a natural ability to connect teams, ideas, and opportunities.

Comfort operating as both strategist and creative technologist, who can drive both impact and storytelling.

Great teammate (roll up your sleeves, adaptable work style, lead via influence, excellent “connector”)

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Customer Solutions (ACS) organization is looking for a Manager, Advanced Analytics and Reporting to lead a team that builds intelligent tools / reports & dashboards, workflows, and ML/AI pipelines driving actionable insights across our Digital Experience business. You will combine technical leadership with people management, guiding a high-performing team that delivers data products to improve adoption, retention, and value realization for our customers.

What You’ll Do

Lead & Develop Teams: Manage and mentor a team of data science engineers and analysts, ensuring a balance of technical depth and business relevance.

Business Insights & Storytelling: Own reporting and analysis of customer success metrics (renewal, adoption, churn risk). Translate data into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for executives and multi-functional leaders.

Data Architecture & Systems: Ensure large datasets are consolidated, cleansed, and integrated across multiple sources to support reliable, enterprise-wide analytics.

AI/ML Engineering: Oversee the design and deployment of scalable ML/AI workflows, predictive models, and LLM-powered agents to automate insights and deliver next-gen customer intelligence.

Multi-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Customer Success, Engineering, Professional Services, and other DX organizations to align data solutions with business priorities. 

Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement in analytics processes, governance, and system scalability.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field.

8+ years of experience in data science, business intelligence, or data engineering roles.

5-7 years of proven people management experience, including hiring, mentoring, and developing diverse technical and analytical teams.

Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for executive audiences (Power BI, Tableau, Adobe Workspace).

Strong expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Proven track record of deploying ML/AI models and building scalable data solutions.

Good communication skills: ability to tell the data story, influence decisions, and partner effectively with senior leaders.

Knowledge of business processes in SaaS, Customer Success, or customer experience domains.

Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to inspire change and deliver outcomes in dynamic environments.

The Opportunity

Adobe purchases products and services from thousands of suppliers each year. We aim to accelerate Adobe's continued commercial success through outstanding strategic sourcing. You will have the chance to lead sourcing projects while you partner with internal teams and suppliers to optimize spend across Adobe's indirect categories.

What you'll do

Lead end-to-end commercial strategy for global cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including complex enterprise agreements, consumption optimization, and long-term capacity planning.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Finance to translate cloud usage patterns into actionable sourcing strategies that reduce total cost of ownership while maintaining performance and resilience.

Develop and execute negotiation strategies for multi-year cloud commitments, marketplace agreements, and emerging cloud-native services.

Utilize governance mechanisms that improve visibility into cloud spend, usage forecasting, and risk management.

Monitor market trends across hyperscalers and cloud ecosystem vendors to inform build vs. buy decisions and long-term platform strategy.

Proactively seek value-creating opportunities across spend categories

Oversee the process of disseminating and following contract obligations, and instituting a complete strategy to approach renewal.

Develop, issue, and coordinate RFx activity and lead commercial negotiations to find the best sourcing solution for Adobe.

Ensure proper risk mitigation through liaising and contributing with Legal. Help internal partners obtain robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure reliable performance.

Report progress on a weekly basis, indicating work planning and work in progress. Add agreements, service details and payment forecasts into procurement systems in a complete and timely manner.

Drive continuous improvement and organizational change initiatives.

What You’ll Need

Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or similar (preference: MBA, or JD).

Strategic Sourcing/Procurement-related industry certification(s) a plus.

Preference: 6-10 years’ experience in Strategic Sourcing with an emphasis in cloud software or software as a service.

Deep market knowledge software contracting trends, licensing models, and business models.

Experience leading teams, formal people leadership preferred. 

Familiarity with fiscal planning cycles and ad hoc financial analysis.

Excellent emotional intelligence (EQ) & influence with various partners, and improving business dynamics both within Global Procurement and broadly across Adobe; evidence of continuous positive customer feedback.

Growth mentality: aware of personal strengths and weaknesses; skilled in receiving, applying, and giving useful feedback.

Mastery of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Familiarity with BI reporting and spend analysis.

High attention to detail and the exercise of sound judgment and decision-making.

Exceptional written and verbal communication, time management and interpersonal skills.

Able to synthesize and present complex matters and data analysis in executive presentation views with insightful commentary.

Willing to train users in new processes, policies, and procedures or technologies.

Effective ownership of competing priorities. Flexible working times based on company requirements and should be expected at various times through the business year and quarter.
