You’ll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape and refine product requirements using your technical and UX instincts — helping the team ship with confidence. 

Test iOS features hands-on, validating end-to-end workflows, interactions, and expected behaviors across devices and configurations. 

 Serve as the first user for every new feature—spotting usability gaps, confusing interactions, missing states, and edge cases before they reach production. 

Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and designers to understand feature intent and ensure test coverage reflects how people actually use the product. 

Write clear, actionable bug reports grounded in user impact and reproducible steps. 

Create and execute test plans across functional, usability, regression, and exploratory testing—adjusting focus as features evolve and priorities shift. 

 Contribute to continuous quality improvement by helping the team learn from regressions, bugs, and direct customer feedback. 

Engage with customers to understand reported issues and clarify expectations for how features should work. 

Use AI-assisted and agentic tools to accelerate common tasks—such as generating test ideas, exploring unusual workflows, analyzing logs and crashes, and highlighting what matters most for the user experience. 

Support release readiness by validating fixes, assessing risk areas, and confirming features meet our agreed-upon quality bar. 
 

What We’re Looking For 

You’ll need: 

4+ years of experience in software quality engineering or testing, including hands-on work with mobile applications. 

Familiarity with iOS applications and workflows—enough platform knowledge to reason about app behavior, states, and edge cases. 

 A strong user-centric mindset—you think about how people will actually use the product, where they might get stuck, and what would feel confusing or broken. 

Comfort working from evolving requirements and early designs, with a habit of asking good questions when things are unclear. 

Experience using AI-assisted tools (or a strong interest in learning them) to improve testing effectiveness—while always validating outputs with care. 

Experience with video editing applications and a solid understanding of mobile video editing workflows. 

Clear written and verbal communication skills, especially when describing issues, steps to reproduce, and user impact. 

The ability to work well on a cross-functional team and balance quality goals with delivery timelines. 
 

Even Better If You Have 

Experience testing creative, media, or video-related applications on mobile platforms. Familiarity with video editing workflows from a user or tester perspective. Exposure to Swift-based iOS apps, build systems, or debugging tools. Experience with exploratory testing, usability testing, or customer-focused validation.

Own and drive the design and evolution of complex, customer-facing software systems, from architecture through production.

Identify, assess, and manage security and technical risk, making defensible decisions with minimal guidance.

Lead design and code reviews, setting a high bar for quality, maintainability, and secure engineering practices.

Mentor and support other engineers, helping raise technical standards and grow expertise across the team.

Significant experience building customer-facing systems at scale.

Job Description
Adobe is dedicated to changing the world through digital experiences. We offer everything needed to build and deliver outstanding experiences to everyone—from emerging artists to global brands. We are passionate about enabling people to develop beautiful images, videos, and apps. We also help companies change how they connect with customers across all screens. Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group invites an Applied Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer passionate about post-training and distillation of large generative AI models to join the team. This role will focus on raising the quality, efficiency, and deployability of Adobe’s generative models for images and videos. The chosen candidate will collaborate with researchers and engineers to build and refine post-training pipelines such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, and model distillation. These efforts will facilitate adapting large complex models into efficient production versions.
This role influences the performance and scalability of Firefly’s generative AI systems, facilitating next-generation creative functionalities for millions of users. As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a distinguished team of applied researchers and engineers committed to developing and improving generative AI systems. You will work alongside data, modeling, and infrastructure groups to implement post-training upgrades into production systems that support Adobe products.
Job Responsibilities

Develop and run distillation pipelines to transfer capabilities from large teacher models into smaller, efficient student models.

Carry out and refine post-training methods including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization (DPO/GRPO), and reward-based learning.

Build infrastructure and tools for teacher rollout creation, distillation data pipelines, and training workflows.

Carry out experiments aimed at improving model quality, efficiency, and instruction alignment for generative AI models.

Collaborate closely with research scientists to convert research ideas into scalable training pipelines and production-ready implementations.

Evaluate models using both automated metrics and human preference signals to guide post-training improvements.

Optimize models for deployment efficiency, including distillation, model compression, and inference performance.

Collaborate with various groups such as data, research, and product units to incorporate post-training improvements into Adobe Firefly systems.

What you need to succeed

Expertise in machine learning algorithms and model distillation techniques

Strong programming skills in Python or similar languages

Experience with AI model training and optimization

Preferred qualifications: Advanced degree or relevant experience in a related field, background in large-scale data pipelines, and knowledge of Adobe products.

The opportunity 

Adobe is looking for Director of Research & Strategy for Adobe Express. You will lead a group of passionate and hard-working researchers and strategists shaping experiences across web, mobile, and desktop applications to develop a rich Adobe Express ecosystem, while using AI/ML technologies to enable individual and business creativity and productivity across enterprise users and teams.

Partnering closely with Design, Product and Engineering executives, you will provide strategic design and product direction, feedback to the design and engineering teams to uplevel craft, and find resolution to ambiguous problem spaces across the entire Express ecosystem.

What you’ll do

Build and lead a high-performing research and strategy team; coaching senior talent, attracting top-tier leaders, and fostering a culture of rigor, growth, and impact.

Build a collaborative environment and encourage deep partnership with cross-functional teams, setting a high bar for research craft and embedding research into strategic planning and execution. 

Define and execute research strategy for redesigns, new audiences and product directions, and lead all aspects of research execution across releases on multiple platforms.

Contribute to product strategy discussions through deep customer research and design partnerships to bring visions to life.

Influence cross-functional leaders to act on insights, driving measurable improvements in user and business outcomes.

What you need to succeed 

10+ years of equivalent practical experience of managing researchers, strategists, and research leaders.

Lead empathetically, fostering an inclusive and empowering environment for the research team to do innovative and impactful work.

Experience working directly with executives on ambiguous problems and crafting big picture strategies grounded in deep user understanding.

Exceptional oral and written communication skills are a pre-requisite; able to tailor narratives and presentations for executive, product and design audiences. 

Have leveraged AI solutions as part of an overall research program

Connect research to business strategy, framing insights as actionable recommendations that resonate with executive audiences.

Be an effective facilitator across product-design-research-engineering teams in early stages of key projects and initiatives.

Deep expertise in strategic problem framing and solving problems.

Embody a learner and mentor mentality; actively grow senior researchers and emerging leaders.

Champion for customer-centric and holistic design at all levels in the organization.

The Opportunity

Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (Real-Time CDP) helps companies bring together known and anonymous data from multiple enterprise sources in order to create customer profiles that can be used to provide personalized customer experiences across all channels and devices in real time.

You are more than welcome in our group of engineers who build the systems connecting Real-Time CDP to a large ecosystem of partners, from on-site or in-app personalization to email, paid media, call centers, connected devices, and more.

In collaboration with a larger distributed team of product and engineering experts, we innovate, craft and operate distributed micro services and BigData processing applications powering hundreds of partner integrations.

This role blends data infrastructure, AI workflows, and multi-cloud technologies to drive real-time customer intelligence. If you enjoy solving complex challenges and working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!

What you'll Do

Design, build and deliver distributed, resilient, scalable, highly available services for BigData applications
Research on various technologies useful for the project and keep in touch with the evolution of the industry
Deploy, monitor and maintain the services you build
Use brand new AI tools to boost your software engineering efficiency
Apply software quality principles by performing code reviews, assuring code coverage and analyze cost efficiency for developed code
Perform on-call activities, on rotation with the rest of the team
Be involved in all the product development and delivery stages, as part as an agile engineering team.
Work in an environment that supports individual growth and continuous learning.

What you need to succeed
9+ years of backend software engineering experience
Strong knowledge of JVM languages (Java/Scala) and deep experience in crafting scalable and distributed applications.
Experience developing and maintaining micro-services, REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, DevOps principles and observability tools
Hands-on experience in using AI tools for practical applications to improve productivity and efficiency across diverse work environments.
Able to collaborate with other teams and roles to transform the business requirements into feature specs, establish integration design, resolve dependencies and adopt best-practices.
Able to communicate technical details clearly to all levels of the organization. Excellent written and spoken English.

Bonus Skills
Experience with distributed systems, large-scale data processing (Spark, Kafka, Hadoop), and real-time stream or batch data architecture.

Sr. Software Development Engineer – Media Analytics 

Our Company 
From the moment you wake up until you go to bed, think about the media you consume and the adverts you see. Consider the apps you use, the websites you browse, and nearly all your online shopping during the day. Almost every one of these experiences involves an Adobe product. 

 

 

The Challenge 

Adobe Streaming Media powers large-scale digital experiences, including live events and streaming platforms. These systems operate under strict requirements for latency, reliability, cost efficiency, and data correctness. 

Media Analytics is a mature, critically important product where stability and predictability are essential. This environment requires thoughtful integration of AI-assisted analytics and human-led workflows within production systems. 

AI capabilities are developed and deployed alongside real distributed systems, streaming pipelines, and operational constraints. 

 

 

The Role 

We are seeking an Sr. Software Development Engineer to contribute to the evolution of data and service platforms behind Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics. 

This role focuses on: 

Distributed systems 

Event streaming architectures 

Operational excellence 

Analytics and workflows refined by artificial intelligence 

You will help build and maintain systems that remain reliable and accurate under high traffic conditions, while enabling AI-powered capabilities such as assisted insights, conversational analytics, and automated workflows. 

 

What You’ll Work On 

Build and operate cloud-native, distributed platforms for analytics and AI-enabled features 

Develop and improve event-driven and streaming platforms such as Kafka and related technologies 

Translate product and business requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions 

Identify and address performance, reliability, and cost challenges in existing systems 

Contribute across the development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring 

Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response and system reliability improvements 

Integrate AI/ML capabilities into production systems built on strong data foundations 

Collaborate with and support other engineers to improve overall system quality 

 

What We’re Looking For 

This role combines elements of software engineering and AI integration. It is suited for engineers who recognize the importance of strong system foundations in enabling effective AI capabilities. 

What You Need to Succeed 

4+ years of experience building or operating distributed systems, backend services, or large-scale data platforms 

Experience with event streaming or messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Kinesis) 

Experience with data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Flink) 

Familiarity with production environments, including Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and incident response 

Experience designing and operating RESTful services 

Proficiency in Java (Python or other languages are also valuable) 

Focus on reliability, performance, and cost efficiency in system design 

 

AI-Related Expectations 

This role does not require deep research expertise in AI. 

However, candidates should be able to: 

Incorporate AI/ML functionalities into production systems 

Evaluate system behavior, observability, and failure scenarios related to AI features 

Apply responsible AI principles, including privacy, transparency, and safety 

Treat AI components within the overall system architecture 

 

Nice to Have 

Experience with Scala 

Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or Argo 

Experience with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) 

Experience operating systems under high-traffic conditions 

Exposure to AI-enabled features, LLM APIs, or production AI systems 

Familiarity with monitoring AI/ML performance and data quality 

 

Why This Role 

Contribute to a widely used, production-grade platform 

Help shape how AI is integrated into large-scale analytics systems 

Work on systems with real users, real workloads, and measurable impact 

Participate in platform-level decision making and technical direction

The Opportunity

We are the market leader in software products and services for the creative & marketing ecosystem with Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Express, Firefly and Experience Cloud.

Adobe has made industry-leading progress in addressing the enterprise need for new, scalable ways to create ideas and assets with GenAI-infused workflows and products. Adobe Digital Media’s recent launch of GenAI-powered products for enterprises includes Firefly Services (APIs), Firefly Custom Models, Object Composites, Style Kits and unique AI features within flagship products like Adobe Photoshop, Express and Adobe GenStudio.

We are looking for an outstanding Machine Learning Engineer to research, design, develop and deliver high-profile products that span GenAI features and customization of GenAI Firefly models to empower the next generation of enterprise creators and marketers everywhere by turning creative intent into creative success. As a part of this team shaping the future of our core Intelligence Layer powering these GenAI features for enterprises around the world.

What you'll do

Research, train, and deploy SOTA ML models for enterprise use-cases

Leverage LLMs to analyze complex data and build advanced knowledge-extraction and insight-generation systems

Explore and iterate on emerging LLM techniques to advance the frontier of Context Engineering

Build and optimize agentic AI workflows that enable users to dynamically interact and refine outputs from ML systems

Develop scalable frameworks to evaluate the accuracy, robustness and usability of complex AI agents

Partner closely with product, UX, business development and strategic partners to translate AI innovations into enterprise-grade production features

Collaborate with AI Research team to constantly explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies and transform research ideas into interactive prototypes

What you need to succeed

B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience

4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production

Demonstrated expertise in training, finetuning, optimizing LLMs / large-scale models

Proficiency in Python and deep knowledge of leading ML frameworks and libraries

Strong passion for AI-driven innovation and a track record of delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

About the Role

The Manager of Customer Advocacy and Insights owns the end-to-end process of capturing, synthesizing, and activating customer insights across the organization. What You’ll Do

Aggregate and synthesize customer insights from customer meetings, notes, recordings, and field interactions into clear, actionable narratives.

Build, maintain, and evolve a centralized repository of customer use cases, success stories, and deal deconstructions that can be easily accessed by the field.

Write and distribute win wires and customer success stories that proactively highlight customer outcomes, value realization, and standard methodologies.

Ensure sales teams and cross-functional partners have access to accurate, up-to-date customer insights for reference, enablement, and decision-making.

Translate customer feedback and themes into compelling written and visual communications aligned to organizational priorities and strategy.

Partner closely with Sales leadership, Operations, Enablement, and other cross-functional collaborators to embed customer insights into workflows and initiatives.

Champion and continuously improve the customer insights process, ensuring it is scalable, repeatable, and easy to engage with.

Proactively identify emerging customer trends, challenges, and opportunities, and surface insights that inform strategic discussions.

Represent the voice of the customer across the organization while modeling Adobe’s values and customer-first approach.

What We’re Looking For

Exceptional writing and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to tell clear, compelling stories from qualitative insights.

Experience working closely with Sales teams and familiarity with sales motions, deal cycles, and customer use cases.

Strong qualitative analysis skills, with comfort synthesizing unstructured inputs rather than relying on quantitative dashboards.

Proven ability to own, design, and champion processes that make insights accessible, useful, and actionable.

Comfort collaborating across functions and influencing without direct authority.

Strategic problem solver who can also complete tasks tactically and independently.

Highly organized, diligent, and proactive in finding opportunities to add new value.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

5+ years of experience in customer insights, sales enablement, customer advocacy, sales operations, or a related role.

Demonstrated experience building customer use cases, success stories, or internal-facing insight communications.

Strong collaborator management skills and experience working with senior leaders.

Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Experience in technology or SaaS environments preferred.

Adobe's Student Engagement Marketing team exists to encourage the long-term use of Adobe's tools with students and universities, with a particular focus on embedding Adobe Firefly and AI-powered workflows into the everyday practices of video and design students.

We’re looking for a highly creative Marketing Specialist to build, manage and energise our student evangelist presence across key design and film schools in the UK. This person will identify, grow, and nurture a passionate group of design & video students at some of the most prestigious universities in the country to champion Adobe’s brand and tools, and build usage of our latest technology with their peer groups.

This role is suited to someone immersed in creative culture, with a deep understanding of the motivations and challenges of design and video students. It’s a highly hands‑on role - you’ll spend real time with students, listening, advising, and being present in their creative world!

What You’ll Do

Student Advocacy & Campus Marketing

Own the day-to-day execution of the UK student evangelist marketing program, managing a cohort of 30–50 students across priority institutions.

Build trusted 1:1 relationships with student evangelists, serving as their point of contact and mentor at Adobe. You’ll be the person they trust and come to for honest feedback – supporting their growth into confident campus voices!

Help evangelists confidently represent Adobe in their own way on campus, ensuring they understand our tools, positioning, and expectations, while empowering them to engage peers authentically.

Drive measurable adoption of creative and AI tools through evangelist‑led activity and campus marketing moments, using engagement and usage insights to continuously refine programming.

Enablement & Programming

Develop and deliver training, enablement and opportunities that enable student evangelists to confidently use and promote Adobe tools within real projects and student workflows.

Support evangelists in planning and delivering activations, workshops, and content that introduce Adobe tools to new student audiences.

Curate exclusive programming and benefits, reinforcing the value of the role, and supporting skill development and industry access.

Content, Insight & Student Voice

Guide and elevate student‑led content and experiences, ensuring output is culturally relevant, on-brand, and aligned to Adobe’s product vision.

Set and maintain the cultural feel of the program, creating “insider” spaces (e.g. Discord or private socials) that spark participation, ownership, and ongoing creative momentum.

Actively gather insight from students, capturing sentiment, product feedback, and emerging needs to inform wider Adobe marketing and product teams.

Collaboration & External Relationships

Work closely with universities, faculty, and internal partners to unlock campus opportunities, and enable deeper creative and industry‑connected experiences.

Partner with Events, Education Sales, and global counterparts to ensure community activity complements larger campaigns and priorities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Highly interpersonal, with the confidence, warmth, and social energy to build trust quickly and sustain close 1:1 relationships.

Enjoys being actively immersed in student life — working directly with students and building relationships through hands‑on interaction.

Has an understanding of youth culture, creative subcultures, and trends.

Brings a thoughtful, credible point of view on AI in the creative industry, and can converse with both enthusiastic and sceptical audiences in an authentic way.

Energised by fast‑paced, evolving environments, keeping pace with rapid change across creative tools, workflows, and AI innovation.

Combines strong communication and organisational skills, able to translate ideas into clear plans, execution, and measurement.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in youth marketing or ambassador programs within the creative, video, or film industries.

Experience facilitating workshops, peer‑to‑peer learning, or student‑led events.

Experience studying graphic design, creative media or film.

Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including Photoshop and Premiere.

The Opportunity

Structured Content is at the heart of the engines powering the new age Experiences such as Chatbots, Voice Based Devices, Fluid and Omni-Channel content delivery. In Technical Communication group of Adobe, we are developing a new age Component Content Management System which powers the journey of Structured Content for large enterprises. Scale and efficiency are key here. Millions of documents are published regularly to multiple platforms and channels across the industry using this solution. We have a strong vision and we are looking for a highly motivated, technically driven and hands on leader to realize it for our product.
 

About the Team:

AEM Guides is a new age technology CCMS. It is used by Fortune-500 companies which publish millions of documents regularly using this product. It is a unique opportunity to work in a startup like environment within a large organization where all product functions collaborate closely with the business counterparts and with the large enterprise customers. Given the enterprise business domain and the startup nature of the team, we are growing fast and scaling the product scope and customer base at a very rapid pace.
 

The Challenge

As a Senior Computer Scientist, you will go beyond traditional coding responsibilities to lead and shape complex features within our systems. Your role will focus on:

Architecting Scalable Solutions: Design and implement features that integrate seamlessly with our broader system architecture, leveraging Adobe Experience Manager capabilities to manage customer workflows, and drive actionable insights.

Complex Systems Integration: Ensure that new features interact effectively with existing components, maintaining high performance and reliability.

Advanced Algorithmic Design: Develop and optimize algorithms to solve complex problems, applying sophisticated design principles to enhance system functionality.

Strategic Design Judgment: Make informed, high-level design decisions that align with long-term product goals and architectural standards.

Product and Technology Expertise: Stay ahead of the emerging technologies, using this knowledge to drive innovation and continuously improve our offerings.

We are looking for passionate and driven senior architects who can translate intricate product features into scalable, efficient solutions. Your expertise in architectural decision-making and team mentoring will be crucial to our success and innovation in the marketing technology space.
 

Roles & Responsibilities:

This is an individual contributor position. Expectations will be on the below lines:

Responsible for design and architecture of new services and features

Well versed in emerging industry technologies and trends, and the ability to channel that knowledge to the team and use it to influence product direction.

Be responsible for all phases of engineering. From early specs, design/architecture, technology choice, development, unit-testing/integration automation, and deployment.

Collaborate with architects, product management and other engineering teams to build the services and product features

Build technical specifications, prototypes and presentations to communicate your ideas.

Participate in resolution of production issues and develop solutions to prevent future issues from happening again

Orchestrate with team to develop a product or parts of a large product.
 

Required Skills & Expertise:

5-8 years of experience in technical roles, proven experience across product life cycle.

Should have excellent computer science fundamentals and a good understanding of design, and performance of algorithm.

Experience in scaling and leading teams building solution with cloud technologies

Deep expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks like React.js, Angular and proficient in state management libraries (e.g., Redux, MobX, or Vuex).

Strong knowledge of Node.js, JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript for building scalable applications.

In-depth understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).

Expertise in optimizing frontend performance, including lazy loading, code splitting, and minimizing asset size.

Proficient in tools like Lighthouse, Webpack, and Rollup.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and deploying frontend applications.

Proficient in testing frameworks like Jest, Mocha, Cypress, or Puppeteer.

Experience in writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.

Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.

Experience in handling WebSocket and real-time data updates

Experience with server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG)

Ability to build consensus & drive decisions in ambiguous scenarios

Excellent work ethics and highly motivated

Excellent oral and written communication skills (interpersonal and client-facing)

Ability to manage systems development scope and changes in the context of the business environment.

Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
 

Architectural Skills

Scalable Design Patterns:

Ability to design scalable, modular, and maintainable frontend architectures.

Expertise in micro-frontends and component-driven development.

Performance Monitoring:

Familiarity with tools like Adobe Analytics, New Relic, or Sentry to monitor application performance.

Component Libraries:

Experience in designing and maintaining reusable component libraries using tools like Storybook.

Code Reviews & Standards:

Skilled in conducting thorough code reviews and enforcing best practices.

System Design:

Strong understanding of system design principles for large-scale web applications.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to contribute to the development of a large-scale Windows desktop photo editing application-Adobe Express. The role involves building high-performance features in a complex, multi-process architecture while maintaining strong standards around performance, memory efficiency, and reliability. The ideal candidate will have experience in image editing systems and modern AI-assisted development workflows, and will be comfortable working in a large, evolving codebase.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Development

Design and implement features for a Windows desktop photo editing application with focus on performance, usability, and reliability.

Work within a large codebase to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with long-term product architecture.

Platform & System Engineering

Contribute to development of complex Windows desktop systems involving multi-process architectures and IPC-based communication.

Optimize application performance, memory footprint, and resource utilization across different hardware configurations.

Work with system-level constraints such as rendering pipelines, file handling, and OS integration.

Image Editing Domain

Build and improve image editing capabilities including rendering workflows, editing operations, and UI interactions related to image manipulation.

Ensure high fidelity and responsiveness in editing operations across large images and diverse file formats.

AI-Assisted Development

Leverage generative and agentic AI technologies to improve development efficiency, prototyping speed, and automation.

Build workflows that use AI to accelerate feature development, testing, and debugging while maintaining strong engineering validation standards.

Demonstrate understanding of the strengths and limitations of generative AI tools and apply them responsibly in engineering workflows.

Quality & Engineering Discipline

Maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, and system stability.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure features meet performance, reliability, and usability expectations.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in software development with strong proficiency in C++ or C# for Windows desktop applications.

Experience working on large codebases with complex architecture.

Hands-on experience building or contributing to image editing or graphics-related applications.

Experience developing Windows desktop applications with understanding of OS-level behaviors and performance considerations.

Experience working with multi-process architectures and IPC-based communication models.

Strong understanding of performance optimization, memory management, and system resource constraints.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration + Adobe Creativity & Productivity) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

 

Why This Role Matters 

Technology is one of the most rapidly evolving industries in the world—shaped by AI, cloud-driven engagement, platform ecosystems, new monetization models, and a global focus on speed, scale, and customer-centricity. Adobe’s customers need a trusted guide who can help them reimagine digital experiences across this landscape. 

This role ensures Adobe shows up with clarity, leadership, and conviction—helping define the future of Technology digital experience and enabling both established leaders and emerging innovators.

Role Summary 

We are seeking a PMO lead to oversee a complex, multiyear, multi workstream strategic partnership involving co-innovation, solution development, services delivery, product integration, and coordinated GTM activation. 

This role serves as the central program leader responsible for ensuring operational rigor, workstream discipline, cross functional synchronization, structured governance, and predictable execution across all partnership activities. The PMO Lead ensures that all workstream sponsors follow through on their commitments, business cases, and delivery milestones while also coordinating closely with internal functions such as legal, sourcing, finance, product, engineering, partner marketing, and field teams. 

This is a high visibility role that requires exceptional program leadership, strong commercial acumen, and experience orchestrating complex crossfunctional initiatives in fast moving environments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Governance & Operating Cadence 

Own and operate the end-to-end governance model across all participating organizations. 

Establish and run structured partnership cadences, including monthly, quarterly, and executive level reviews. 

Manage issue and risk escalation processes across workstream, program, and executive levels. 

Maintain clear and consistent communication loops between workstream owners, alliance management, executive sponsors, and technical leadership. 

Establish and maintain a structured PMO operating model aligned to multi-year strategic investments. 

2. Workstream Oversight 

Oversee execution quality and pacing across all defined workstreams, which may include areas such as presales support, value realization, consulting delivery, product integration, GTM enablement, and innovation programs. 

Ensure each workstream maintains clear deliverables, KPIs, milestones, risks, business case assumptions, and success measurements. 

Track progress across all workstreams through standardized dashboards, status reviews, and structured accountability mechanisms. 

3. SOW Development, Contracting & Compliance 

Lead the orchestration of Statements of Work (SOWs) across all workstreams. 

Coordinate with internal legal, sourcing, finance, and relevant workstream sponsors to ensure timely drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of all SOWs. 

Maintain a comprehensive view of all contractual obligations, delivery timelines, dependencies, and cross functional requirements. 

Monitor SLA compliance for approvals, and onboarding. 

4. Product & Engineering Integration Program Management 

Partner closely with product and engineering teams to ensure that roadmap integration commitments are clearly defined, resourced, and progressing as planned. 

Track endtoend delivery of technical integration milestones. 

Ensure alignment between engineering delivery, workstream interdependencies, and GTM timelines. 

5. GTM, Partner Marketing & Field Alignment 

Drive coordinated GTM execution across partner marketing, sales, and alliance leadership. 

Ensure the creation of messaging, positioning, enablement assets, solution packaging, and field ready materials. 

Support demand generation initiatives, joint marketing motions, and field activation programs. 

Partner with the partner management team to track adoption metrics, pipeline influence, and revenue aligned outcomes associated with the joint solutions. 

6. Investment Oversight/Management 

Maintain comprehensive oversight of the company’s multiyear strategic commitment with the external partner under the governing commercial agreement. 

Track all spending across workstreams, ensuring alignment to agreed upon annual and total targets set forth in the partnership framework. 

Reconcile all Eligible Fees, monitor burn rate, and validate quarterly spend reports received from the partner, including identifying discrepancies and driving resolution through the governance process. 

Ensure spend progress is accurately reflected against each workstream’s commitments, success measures, and performance expectations. 

Maintain realtime visibility into pacing, forecasts, risks, and remaining balance toward the overall spend commitment, providing structured insights to senior leadership. 

Coordinate closely with workstream sponsors, sourcing, legal, finance, and partner management teams to ensure all spending is properly attributed, contractually compliant, and aligned to strategic outcomes. 

Support governance reviews by preparing executive ready summaries of investment performance, pacing, risks, and mitigation plans. 

7. Executive Reporting & Insights 

Create executive ready reports summarizing progress across workstreams, technical integrations, GTM activities, risks, and program health. 

Provide structured insights, scenario analysis, and data driven recommendations to senior leadership. 

Maintain realtime dashboards on program performance, risks, and strategic milestones. 

Success Metrics 

Success for this role includes: 

Operational discipline and predictability across all workstreams 

Timely execution of SOWs, integration milestones, and GTM deliverables 

Institutionalized governance rhythms with consistent cross functional participation 

Highquality strategic reporting to executive and cross functional leadership 

Measurable impact on product integration progress, solution readiness, and GTM performance 

Positive stakeholder feedback across internal teams and partner organizations 

Experience & Qualifications 

Required 

10+ years of PMO leadership or enterprise program management experience 

Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multiworkstream programs 

Experience coordinating across product, engineering, sales, legal, sourcing, and marketing functions 

Strong financial, operational, and commercial acumen 

Exceptional communication skills and executive presence 

Ability to drive clarity, alignment, and accountability across matrixed teams 

Preferred 

Background in SaaS, digital experience platforms, enterprise transformations, or co-innovation programs 

Experience with ecosystem partnerships, creative/marketing technology, or AI enabled workflows 

Familiarity with large scale GTM motions and joint solution development 

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months 

Governance operating rhythm fully established and adopted 

Relevant workstream SOWs executed on time and aligned to program requirements 

Stakeholders across all functions report high satisfaction with program structure and execution 

Program is operating predictably, transparently, and with clear accountability

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Administrative Assistant who treats executive calendar and operations management as a craft. You will support two senior leaders in Adobe’s GenStudio organization — a high-growth, GenAI-powered product area.

The executives you support run cross-functional product or marketing organizations with heavy inbound meeting demand from engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer stakeholders. The right candidate understands business context well enough to make real-time prioritization decisions about what gets calendar time and what doesn’t — without being told.

You will also serve as an operational anchor for executives who move fast and get pulled in many directions simultaneously. That means keeping them on schedule, reminding them what’s next, flagging when they’re about to miss a commitment, and maintaining composure when priorities shift rapidly throughout the day.

What Sets You Apart

You understand the business, not just the calendar. You learn the executive’s priorities, stakeholder map, and active workstreams so you can make smart scheduling decisions autonomously. When an executive requests time, you know whether it’s urgent or can wait — and you act accordingly.

You own outcomes, not tasks. You don’t wait to be told a conflict exists — you surface it and propose a solution before the executive notices.

You keep pace under pressure. When priorities shift three times before lunch, you stay calm, reprioritize, and communicate changes clearly. You thrive in high-tempo environments and don’t freeze when things move fast.

You keep the executive accountable. You are comfortable telling the executive what needs to happen next, pulling them out of a meeting that’s running over, and reminding them of commitments they’ve lost track of. You see yourself as an operational partner, not a support function.

You build systems, not workarounds. Repeating processes frustrate you. You build templates, standing blocks, and protocols that prevent problems from recurring.
 

What You Will Own

Calendar Strategy & Prioritization (Primary)

Business-context-driven scheduling: Understand the executive’s priorities, active workstreams, and stakeholder landscape well enough to make informed decisions about which meetings to accept, decline, or reschedule — without requiring executive input on every request.

Proactive conflict resolution: Own the end-to-end executive calendar across Outlook. Identify and resolve conflicts before they surface — daily, not weekly. When inbound demand is high, triage based on urgency and business impact.

Stakeholder coordination: Schedule and reschedule across cross-functional leadership, external partners, and direct reports with clear communication to all affected parties.

Weekly reconciliation: Maintain a standing weekly sync with each executive to align priorities, flag upcoming conflicts, and confirm the next week’s schedule.

Meeting hygiene: Ensure every calendar invite includes agendas, prep materials, and correct attendees. Decline or defer low-priority requests on behalf of executives.
 

Executive Time Management & Pacing

Keep the executive on track: Proactively remind the executive of upcoming meetings, hard stops, and commitments throughout the day. When the executive gets pulled into unplanned conversations or runs over, you are the one who brings them back on schedule.

Protect focus time: Build and defend blocks for deep work, prep time, and flows across meetings. Push back on requests that erode these blocks without a strong business reason.

Surface what needs attention: Flag overdue action items, approaching deadlines, and commitments the executive may have lost visibility on.

Meeting Preparation & Follow-Up

Prepare briefing documents and context materials ahead of leadership reviews and external meetings.

Track recurring commitments (QBRs, planning cycles, leadership reviews) and proactively build them into the calendar.

Travel & Expenses

Coordinate domestic and international business travel end-to-end: flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.

Submit and reconcile expense reports in a timely manner, flagging any policy questions proactively.

Team Events & Operations

Plan and implement team offsites, all-hands meetings, team-building activities, and cross-functional events.

Coordinate space planning, floor moves, and team logistics as needed.

Provide on-site support at Adobe events and conferences (occasional travel required).

Cross-Functional EA Coordination

Build strong relationships with EAs across Adobe to facilitate cross-org scheduling.

Provide backup coverage during PTO, illness, or sabbatical for peer EAs.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience supporting Sr. Director-level or above executives in a fast-paced technology company.

Expert-level calendar management in Outlook, including multi-executive scheduling across time zones and high-volume inbound meeting requests.

Demonstrated ability to learn business context quickly and use it to make independent scheduling and prioritization decisions.

Proven composure and effectiveness under pressure — comfortable with rapid priority shifts and frequent interruptions throughout the day.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of clear, proactive communication.

Proficiency with Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, and standard enterprise productivity tools.

Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
 

Preferred

Experience supporting product or engineering leadership in a SaaS or enterprise software company.

Track record of building or improving operational processes for executive support.

Familiarity with Adobe tools and internal systems.

BA/BS degree (equivalent experience may substitute).

The Sales Transformation Portfolio Manager plays a critical role in orchestrating how sales transformation initiatives are evaluated, prioritized, governed, and communicated across the organization. This role ensures initiative intake is structured, data is accurate, progress is visible, and leadership has the insights needed to make informed decisions. This individual acts as the connective tissue across strategic programs, business leaders, and cross functional partners. They own the portfolio operating model, ensure data-driven decision-making, and provide transparency into initiative performance, value delivery, and risk areas. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong analytical, operational, and organizational experience with the ability to create clarity, structure, and insight in fast-moving environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Intake, Prioritization, and Planning

Manage the intake process for new sales transformation initiatives, ensuring clear scope, business case, and alignment to strategic objectives.

Develop and manage prioritization frameworks to determine sequencing, dependencies, and resource considerations across the portfolio.

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date source of truth portfolio view, capturing progress, risks, interdependencies, and value delivery.

Partner with leaders across sales, marketing, finance, operations, and product to ensure initiatives are properly defined and positioned for success.

Data Management and Insights

Own initiative data quality across systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

Create standard data structures, definitions, and reporting guidelines for use across the Transformation Office.

Define and maintain portfolio-level KPIs, value realization measures, and reporting logic.

Executive Dashboarding and Visibility

Translate complex program data into meaningful insights for executive audiences.

Provide timely reporting to leadership, enabling informed decisions and proactive interventions.

Governance and Operating Rhythm

Establish and manage the governance framework used to monitor progress, escalate risks, and ensure accountability across initiatives.

Lead cross portfolio forums, including leadership reviews, operating cadences, and decision-making sessions.

Maintain consistent operating rhythms, guiding the organization through structured, predictable, and transparent review cycles.

Frameworks, Standards, and Tooling

Own the Transformation Office’s portfolio and program delivery standards, frameworks, templates, and methodologies.

Define and enforce consistent practices across initiative planning, reporting, and status management.

Evaluate, implement, and manage tooling to support portfolio management, reporting, and collaboration.

Partner with program leaders to ensure adoption and consistent application of standards and tools.

Cross Functional Partnership and Enablement

Partner closely with program managers and business leaders to maintain high-quality plans, data, and reporting.

Support initiative teams in following the Transformation Office framework and best practices.

Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and operational excellence across the transformation ecosystem.

Qualifications:

Required

8–12+ years of experience in portfolio management, PMO operations, transformation support, or strategic program management.

Proven experience managing cross-functional portfolios and creating prioritization or governance models.

Strong analytical skills with experience designing dashboards and communicating insights to executive audiences.

Ability to design and operationalize frameworks, standards, and scalable processes.

Demonstrated success bringing structure, clarity, and organization to complex, ambiguous environments.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex information.

Preferred

Experience within a Transformation Office, Enterprise PMO, or Strategy/Operations team.

Background supporting sales, go-to-market, or revenue-driving initiatives.

Familiarity with portfolio management or BI tools such as Smartsheet, Workfront, Tableau, or Power BI.

Experience in SaaS, technology, or consulting environments.

Key Competencies

Portfolio management and prioritization

Governance and operating model design

Data quality, metrics, and dashboarding

Executive reporting and storytelling

Cross-functional coordination

Process design and standardization

Analytical problem solving

Organizational clarity and structure

Why This Role Matters

This role is foundational to the effectiveness of the Sales Transformation Office. Overview

Adobe is seeking a Director to lead its Global ERC operations, based in Bengaluru. This role is perfect for ambitious professionals looking to drive HR initiatives, ensuring flawless service delivery and innovation. You will be at the heart of Adobe's global HR strategy, working to successfully implement transformative projects that improve our global model and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Global Operations

Establish and complete the multi-year global service delivery strategy aligned with enterprise HR and business priorities.

Own and evolve the Global ERC operating model, including governance, regional coverage, service scope, tiering model, and blocking issue frameworks.

Lead global transformation initiatives, such as establishing the strategic framework and governance model for contingent workforce operations beginning in India and growing globally.

Find opportunities to shift work strategically from Tier 1 to Tier 0 channels through automation, self-service, and knowledge enablement.

Develop a culture of continuous improvement, bringing to bear process optimization, automation, and technology to improve scalability and employee experience.

People & Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and encourage teams, building a strong bench and succession pipeline.

Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and employee-centric culture, championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and behaviors; provide mentoring and feedback to team members.

Own workforce planning, capacity modeling, and skill development to support current and future business needs globally.

Collaborator Partnership & Governance

Serve as the point of contact for complex, high-risk, or sensitive employee matters involving blocking issues, ensuring appropriate resolution in partnership with COEs, Legal, and regional HR leaders.

Build strong, positive relationships with COEs, regional HR teams, and business leaders to align priorities, manage change, and deliver coordinated solutions.

Establish governance mechanisms to ensure compliance with global and local policies, regulatory requirements, and internal standards.

Represent Global ERC in senior leadership forums, providing clear updates on performance, risks, and central initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Risk Management

Ensure robust documentation, controls, and audit readiness, including SOPs, process governance, and compliance reviews.

Identify operational risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies.

Lead large-scale change initiatives (e.g., new systems, process redesigns, global rollouts), ensuring minimal disruption and strong adoption.

Skill & Experience Requirements

15+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in global or multi-region HR operations or shared services environments.

Demonstrated success in crafting and leading global transformation initiatives and scaling operating models across regions.

Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

Advanced collaborator management capabilities, with experience influencing senior leaders and navigating complex organizational dynamics.

Deep understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, case management, and HR technologies.

Proven ability to lead transformation, manage ambiguity, and inspire change in fast-paced, global environments.

Outstanding communication abilities, enabling clear expression of strategy, performance, and risk to varied audiences.

Strong business insight, data proficiency, and experience building dashboards along with demonstrated decision-making judgment.

Unwavering dedication to confidentiality, ethics, and employee trust.

The Opportunity

Adobe Design is looking for an experienced Senior Designer to join our Document Cloud team, contributing to high-visibility projects by developing strategic design solutions, quality experiences, and scalable concepts for individuals and organizations on mobile devices. 

Adobe Document Cloud products (which include Adobe Acrobat, Sign, and Scan, to name just a few) are ubiquitous in the lives and work of more than 600 million monthly active users. Document Cloud also remains the fastest growing cloud in all of Adobe.

The Document Cloud design team has a long and rich legacy, while still being recognized for innovation year after year. We were recognized for TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023 with our work in Liquid Mode.

About us

Adobe Design builds tools that amplify the world’s ability to create and communicate. We’re a distributed team of designers, researchers, prototypers, content strategists, program managers, and more who work across Adobe’s three product lines: Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

About you

As a key design team member and inspiring leader on this team, you’ll play an integral part in crafting the next generation of productivity tools at Adobe! We are working on projects that help people consume, comprehend, create, and collaborate on documents in new ways. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will use data-driven design to create engaging, user-centered experiences that not only attract and retain users but also enhance the overall value proposition of our product.

What you'll do

Collaborate with product managers, product marketing, engineers, and other designers to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Define design strategy, craft visions for products and experiences, and share with senior executives using your storytelling skills.

Understand and use data to inform design decisions.

Explore design ideas via sketches, storyboards, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.

Establish consistency and efficiency throughout the design and development process by applying and evolving scalable design systems.

Elevate design quality through feedback and collaboration.

What you need to succeed

At least 3-5 years of industry experience in product design with a proven track record of success, and a strong portfolio demonstrating interaction design and cross-platform execution.

A degree in design is not required, but equivalent experience, an exceptional portfolio, and strong resume are.

Proficiency in industry-standard design and prototyping tools, including AI-assisted development, design, and productivity tools.

Expertise leveraging data to define workflows and product-led growth designs.

Knowledge of user-centered design principles and methodologies for mobile design.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively present and articulate design concepts and decisions to product partners.

Strong problem-solving skills, with capability of working independently.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously while working with teams across time zones and different geographic regions.

Experience working with product teams to bring design vision to life.

A love of all things design

Job Description

Principal TAM – P50

Join a dedicated team at Adobe and contribute to the technical success of our largest customers. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to craft the future of Adobe's customer engagement strategy and make a significant impact. You will work with a diverse range of collaborators, applying your expertise to successfully implement innovative solutions and ensuring magnificent execution of customer strategies. This is your chance to be part of a ground-breaking organization that values teamwork, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

Lead Ultimate Support engagement(s) for leading Indian BFSI customers, serving as the technical executive point of contact throughout the Customer's solution usage lifecycle.

Highly focused on advising & consulting and support customer's technical strategy with Adobe Solutions via service delivery plans with clear outcomes.

Assess strategic Customer technical risks and opportunities, driving the extended Adobe team to build and deliver mitigation and "get well" plans with leadership teams.

Drive clear communication across Customer operational areas. Maintain regular and appropriate governance with both internal and external executive teams.

Advocate for Customer across internal Adobe teams. Optimize the client's investment and accelerate task, issue execution, and resolution.

Drive innovation, roadmap influence, standard methodologies, and process improvement back into the Adobe ecosystem.

Responsible for the global engagement model and review cycle across multiple business units and/or brands.

Consolidate collaboration and cadence across all technical partners and influence delivery achievements across multi-solution, multi-discipline engagements.

Work hands-on with Adobe's internal collaborators like Customer Success Management, Managed Services, Engineering, TechOps, Product Management, Support, and the Adobe Consulting practice and third-party partners in support of customer's success.

Lead a matrixed services team that may involve multiple project teams from Adobe or client or partner organizations. Develop efficient & effective working relationships with Customer partners.

Make recommendations on how new and existing features fit within customers' environments, supplying standard methodologies and recommendations.

Lead project-based, consultant-led architectural and design discussions to ensure solutions are optimized and ready for maximum value delivery.

Mentor immediate team members as needed & develop skills within the team.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor's Degree in a related technical industry subject area or equivalent experience. An MBA is preferred.

15+ years of experience in a senior capacity in consultative, customer service, customer success, and/or related roles in digital marketing technology.

Strong executive presence with ability to collaborate across multiple teams throughout Adobe and client-side VPs, including CMOs and CXOs.

Excellent presentation skills, confident phone and conference presence, and the ability to lead meetings, workshops, and reviews in front of any audience size.

Strong conflict-resolution skills to drive closure to customer concerns and open technical issues.

Outstanding customer-facing skills that enable you to represent Adobe best within a customer's environment.

Validated interpersonal, prioritization skills, and an ability to work in a highly matrixed environment.

Capable of driving timely resolution across a broad set of issues with the Customer: technical, architecture, business process, and partnerships.

Ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges to help our customers realize their software investments, efficiencies, advantages, and innovations.

Awareness of development methodologies and technologies, and understanding of and experience with marketing software and domain principles.

Experience with Adobe ecosystem. Business practitioner level knowledge with more than one of the Adobe Experience Cloud products. Adobe DX Certifications are highly desirable.

Validated experience working with BFSI clients, with a deep understanding of key challenges such as compliance, personalization, omnichannel engagement, and the implications of industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS) on data management.

Ability to travel to the Mumbai client location (approximately 50-75 percent) as required.

The Challenge 

We are looking for a highly motivated individuals knowledgeable in ML Ops/ Platform engineering to be part of our Advertising Cloud Search, Social, Commerce, a leading digital marketing spend optimization platform helping enterprise clients achieving their marketing goals. We are now faced with exciting challenge of continuing the legacy and at the same time evolving and owning the digital marketing space through our innovative solutions. It's a robust agile team that collaborates and works across all functions of true product development. You must be that individual who is highly engaged, motivated and excels at critical thinking and problem solving!

What you’ll do

Model Lifecycle Management: Manage model versioning, deployment strategies, rollback mechanisms, and A/B testing frameworks. Coordinate model registries, artifacts, and promotion workflows in collaboration with ML Engineers Develop CI/CD and orchestration workflows using GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Airflow, Argo Workflows, or similar tools.

Review and optimize data science models, including code refactoring, containerization, deployment, versioning, and performance tuning. Implement model testing, validation, and automated QA pipelines, ensuring reproducibility and compliance. 

Monitor models in production, including data drift, concept drift, performance degradation, and system reliability. 

Collaborate multi-functionally with data scientists, data engineers, and architects; build documentation and improve team processes. 

Ensure governance, security, and compliance for ML pipelines (access controls, audit logs, model reproducibility, lineage). 

What you need to succeed

Bachelor's degree or advanced degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field. 

Strong ability to design and implement cloud architectures for end-to-end ML workflows on AWS.

Hands-on experience with MLOps frameworks like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow or similar. 

Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), and enterprise platforms like OpenShift. 

Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with Go, Ruby, or Bash scripting. Experience with common ML libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch. 

Experience with software engineering guidelines including version control, testing, and automation. 

Ability to understand data science workflows, experiment tracking, and feature engineering tools. 

Strong communication skills; ability to work collaboratively in multi-functional teams.

Knowledge of cloud services such as AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI. 

Exposure to feature stores like Feast, Tecton, or Databricks Feature Store. 

Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Datadog). 

Experience implementing model governance & lineage with tools like MLflow Registry, SageMaker Model Registry, or Vertex ML Metadata. 

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Financial Analyst provides comprehensive financial support for the Liberty manufacturing site, with a strong focus on financial performance monitoring, standard costing, forecasting, month‑end close, and analytical tool development. This role collaborates closely with Operations and site leadership to ensure accuracy of financial data, improve cost visibility, and support data‑driven decision‑making across the manufacturing environment. The position serves as the site’s subject matter expert for costing and financial reporting.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Monitor site financial and operational results by comparing Actuals vs. Plan and LBE across cost centers and GL accounts

Analyze spending trends, identify material variances, and recommend actions to improve performance

Prepare and distribute financial reports and site reporting packages by gathering, validating, and analyzing financial data

Consolidate Actuals and LBE submissions across site functions for review with Division HQ and Site Leadership

Create dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs to improve visibility

Act as the site SME for financial reporting processes and data accuracy

Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning

Develop detailed financial forecasts using historical data, trends, and current business drivers.

Support development of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and the Latest Best Estimate (LBE

Monitor departmental spending versus budget and highlight variances using system‑generated reports

Build and maintain forecasting models, tracking tools, and financial templates to support planning processes

Accounting & Month-End Close Support

Prepare journal entries and assist with the month‑end close to ensure timely and accurate site financial reporting

Monitor, track, and reconcile key balance sheet accounts

Support standard financial controls and ensure accuracy of reported results

Standard Costing & Cost Accounting

Support the annual standard cost update process, including BOMs, routings, labor rates, overhead rates, and cost build reviews

Ensure manufacturing product costs are accurate, updated, and aligned with operational changes

Analyze and explain manufacturing variances (material usage, labor, overhead, PPV, scrap, absorption, etc.) to Operations leadership

Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to identify and support cost‑reduction initiatives

Ensure strong controls around cost rolls, inventory valuation, and manufacturing accounting

Financial Analysis & Business Support

Perform financial analyses to support site leadership and deliver insights that drive operational and strategic decisions.

Act as a Finance Business Partner by collaborating closely with Operations and other functional leaders to provide financial guidance, interpret results, and support data‑driven operational decisions.

Support evaluation of spending initiatives and operational changes through financial modeling.

Systems, Data Integrity & Reporting Tools

Manage site financial data processes, including uploading, retrieving, reconciling, and validating data to ensure accuracy across reporting systems

Use SAP to load and maintain standard cost data, run financial and operational reports, and extract information needed for variance analysis and cost reviews

Develop automated tools, models, dashboards, and reporting solutions to enhance data reliability and efficiency.

Improve financial reporting processes and ensure high-quality data governance across systems

Collaboration & Working Style

Establish and maintain strong cross‑functional relationships with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and leadership teams

Collaborate effectively across the site to gather data and communicate financial insights

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE YOU'LL BRING

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or related field

Minimum 4 years of experience in FP&A, Cost Accounting, Manufacturing Finance, or similar roles

Strong knowledge of standard costing and manufacturing financial processes (critical requirement)

Experience in a manufacturing environment

Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills (PivotTables, formulas, data modeling, VBA)

Strong accounting knowledge and understanding of financial statements

Experience working with SAP

Experience with financial reporting tools and data analysis

Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills

High attention to detail and accuracy

Ability to work independently and cross‑functionally

Strong presentation skills and comfort working with leadership

Continuous improvement mindset

Proactive, resourceful, and able to learn quickly

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in finance, Accounting, or Business

Experience with Dodeca or similar reporting/consolidation tools

Familiarity with cost optimization, variance analysis, and KPI development

Experience developing financial dashboards, models, and automation tools
